audience: Slovak accounting firms and businesses that process bookkeeping documents in Doklado

useCases.title: Read documents of one organization
useCases.text: Find the organization id by its IČO, then list its documents in a date range, page by page.

useCases.title: Check the unprocessed documents
useCases.text: List the documents in the Unprocessed section. Set the limit to 0 to get only the count.

useCases.title: Review bank transactions for a period
useCases.text: List the bank transactions of the organization that the API key can access, in a date range.

useCases.title: Get attachments and change history
useCases.text: Get download links for the attachments of documents. Read the change history of the documents you name in one call.

useCases.title: Mark documents as exported
useCases.text: Set the export status of documents after they reach your accounting software. This changes the customer's Doklado data.
